remark:
1. It is represented that the parking mentioned under the Tab common areas and facilities is inclusive of visitors parking. Promoter has earmarked parking for each unit. Further, the EWS/ LIG units have been allocated with 90 two-wheeler parking which will be within the Commercial Block in Phase IA.  The Promoter represents that the each EWS unit has been allotted with 1 two-wheeler parking, whereas LIG unit has been allotted with 2 two-wheeler parking as per the provisions of CMJAY. The Promoter further represents that no parking has been allotted to the commercial units/ shops in Phase IA.. 
2. The project is being developed in a phase wise manner wherein the common area would be developed with the phases of the project in which they fall. Further, the common areas developed in phases would form part and portion of the whole project.
3.The Promoter represents that it proposes to develop a group housing project comprising of S+14 floors building which is equal to 44.95 mtr. of height and accordingly prepared drawing and submitted before the JDA, Jaipur for approval. Approval of buildings with height more than 40 mtr. is done by JDA, Jaipur only after approval of the State Government. Therefore, JDA, Jaipur approved and released the building plan upto 40 mtr. of height i.e. S+12 floors building vide its letter dated 06.09.23 and forwarded the proposal of height above 40 mtr. i.e. S+14 to the State Government for approval. The Promoter shall at present commence booking of villas/ units approved as G+1 and G+2 floors and EWS/ LIG units and shops approved as S+10 floors. The Promoter represents that if in future, the State Govt does not grant approval of S+14 floors or grants lesser height than 44.95 mtr as sought for, then the Project shall be having buildings of S+12 floors or S+13 floors, as the case may be.  
4. The project comprises of individual blocks thereby having no central cooling facility in the project.As such, the project does not have any HVAC Consultant

costDetail.n: For the purposes of sub-clause (D) of clause (I) of sub-section (2) of section 4, the land cost shall be the cost incurred by the promoter whether as an outright purchase, lease charges etc.
Revenue or area share given to land owner in lieu of land under any kind of agreement such as Joint Venture, Joint Development etc, in case the Promoter is not the owner of the land.
Amount paid to land owner. (Method of land valuation)
Incidental costs related to acquisition of land such as stamp duty, brokerage, settlement costs of litigation, premiums paid to government authorities related to land.
Interest on finance for purchase of land.
Litigation costs incurred for land acquisition.
Property and other taxes, fees, premiums paid.
Estimated Cost of Construction as certified by Engineer

For the purposes of sub-clause (D) of clause (I) of sub - section (2) of section 4, the construction cost shall be the total cost incurred by the promoter, towards the on - site expenditure for the physical development of the project and includes fees payable to the architects, consultants, project managers / staff including engineers, marketing agents etc. fees / charges / security deposit payable to various departments / authorities, Labor Cess, VAT which are incurred during the development of the project.

On-site expenditure for development of entire project excluding cost of construction as per (ii) above, i.e. 
salaries, consultants fees, site overheads, cost of services (including water, electricity, sewerage), cost of 
machineries and equipment including its hire and maintenance costs, consumables etc. All costs directly 
incurred to complete the construction of the buildings /wings of the project registered
Payment of Taxes, cess, fees, charges, Approval cost for Construction etc. premiums, interest etc. to any statutory Authority
Interest payable to financial institutions, scheduled banks, non-banking financial institution (NBFC) or money lenders on construction funding or money borrowed for construction & Project
